import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length2_54/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length2_54/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Join Source0 and Source1 on 'ID'
merged = pd.merge(source0, source1[['ID', 'sex']], on='ID')

# Group by 'sex' and calculate average of G1, G2, G3 from Source0
grouped = merged.groupby('sex')[['G1', 'G2', 'G3']].mean().reset_index()

# Ensure the column types match the target schema
grouped['sex'] = grouped['sex'].astype(str)
grouped['G1'] = grouped['G1'].astype(float)
grouped['G2'] = grouped['G2'].astype(float)
grouped['G3'] = grouped['G3'].astype(float)

# Sort by 'sex' to have consistent order (optional)
grouped = grouped.sort_values('sex').reset_index(drop=True)

# Write the final target table to the specified path
grouped.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_54/target_multisource.csv", index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the first numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_54/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_54/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Join on ID (primary key)
joined = pd.merge(source0, source1, how='inner', on='ID')

# Group by 'sex' and aggregate averages of G1, G2, G3
result = joined.groupby('sex', as_index=False).agg({
    'G1': 'mean',
    'G2': 'mean',
    'G3': 'mean'
})

# Ensure columns are in the exact order and names as target schema
result = result[['sex', 'G1', 'G2', 'G3']]

# Write output
result.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_54/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
